{{Top|leg}}
'''Giltella Air Base''' was one of two bases close to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cartann City|Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It was here where [[Red Flight]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit, conducted their informal flying school with the [[Adumari]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
